body: A read-only release profile with 1,000 cards measures all seven desktop views and first-card/Settings opening. Three-sample local warm medians are about 38–40 ms outside Calendar, whose dense month grid takes 163 ms; constrained Calendar remains about 999 ms. First-card opening is 33 ms locally / 198 ms under network/CPU emulation; Settings is 43 / 320 ms. Ordinary API reads and displayed-page bounds remain in place. The corrected 96-sample run resets its observer across document reloads; an interrupted exploration is excluded. This ranks costs and does not establish p95, physical-device, VPN or full product acceptance. Duplicate source/lease path traversal is a server candidate requiring release measurement and retained filesystem guards. Evidence: progress/2026-09-30-performance-ranking.md. No application change, scope or card acceptance change is claimed by this report.

metadata.summary: Remaining performance costs ranked across seven views
